prose:
Search Engine Roundtable’s retrieved homepage includes a short report on a collapsible Google Search sidebar for returning to recent AI searches. It attributes a global desktop rollout to a Google representative, while the rest of the page contains unrelated search-news excerpts.

This is limited homepage evidence rather than the full linked article or an account-specific test. A rollout statement does not mean every browser and account already has the feature, and it does not establish how search history is stored or deleted.
highlights: Homepage contains a relevant short excerpt
Feature concerns resuming recent AI searches
Rollout is attributed to a company representative
